Senior Backend Engineer
Remote (UK)

Acme Robotics is looking for a senior backend engineer to own the ingestion pipeline behind our warehouse fleet.

Requirements:
- 5+ years building production services in Python
- Must have deep PostgreSQL experience, including query tuning under load
- Strong experience designing distributed systems that scale to millions of events per day
- Experience mentoring junior engineers and reviewing their work

Nice to have:
- Exposure to Kubernetes
- Familiarity with the logistics or warehousing domain

Responsibilities:
- Own the event ingestion pipeline end to end
- Work with field engineers to debug fleet issues in production
- Set the technical direction for the data platform

Embedded Software Engineer
Bristol, hybrid

Tuv Systems builds industrial sensing hardware. We need an embedded engineer for our next sensor generation.

Requirements:
- 3+ years of C or C++ on embedded targets
- Experience with real-time operating systems
- Must be comfortable debugging with an oscilloscope and a logic analyser

Nice to have:
- Knowledge of CAN bus
- Experience bringing a product through EMC certification

Data Engineer

Requirements:
- Strong SQL and dbt experience
- 4+ years working with Airflow or similar orchestration
- Must have experience with dimensional modelling

Nice to have:
- Experience with Snowflake

Platform Engineer
Remote

Requirements:
- Must have production Kubernetes experience
- 3+ years with Terraform and infrastructure as code
- Experience running CI/CD pipelines at scale
- Strong communication skills for working with product teams

Nice to have:
- Go
- Experience with service meshes
